Metadata.title: FoodSource
Metadata.description: Find and compare food suppliers for restaurants, manufacturers, and procurement teams.

Footer.note: Demonstration catalog. Prices, contacts, and certifications are fabricated and are not commercial offers.

Landing.title: Find food suppliers and compare their terms
Landing.subtitle: FoodSource is for reviewing suppliers by product, category, and city, comparing terms, and keeping a shortlist. Catalog records are labeled as demonstration data.
Landing.searchText: Look up a supplier, product, or category. The query stays in the page address.
Landing.compareText: Place up to three suppliers side by side once the catalog is loaded.
Landing.saveText: Keep a shortlist with notes and a contact status for the demo workspace.
Landing.categoriesText: Choose a category to open the catalog with that name in the search.

Shell.demoBanner: Demonstration data. Information on this platform is not confirmed commercial fact.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Supplier, category, and region summaries will appear after the catalog is loaded.
overview.empty: Metrics are not calculated yet. The database and application shell are in place; supplier records are the next step.

suppliers.title: Suppliers
suppliers.description: Search by supplier, product, and category. City and delivery filters will live on this page.
suppliers.query: The query “{query}” is stored in the page address. Results will appear with the catalog.

compare.title: Comparison
compare.description: Up to three suppliers side by side: price, minimum order, certifications, and delivery.
compare.empty: No suppliers are selected for comparison.

favorites.title: Favorites
favorites.description: Shortlist, notes, and contact status for the demo workspace.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Product categories in Russian and English.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Interface language is switched from the header. Accounts are not connected in this version.
settings.empty: There are no workspace preferences to change yet.

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.description: Check the address or return to the overview.

Catalog.confirmRemoveText: This supplier will leave the shortlist. Notes for this supplier will be deleted too.
Catalog.compareFull: Comparison already has three suppliers. Remove one on the comparison page.
Catalog.actionFailed: That action did not complete. Refresh the page and try again.
Catalog.notePlaceholder: This note stays in the demo workspace
Catalog.scoreHint: Score uses category, geography, price, MOQ, certifications, and delivery. It is not a supplier audit.

Dashboard.title: Overview
Dashboard.description: Summary of the demonstration catalog. Counts come from loaded records, not from the market.
Dashboard.errorText: The catalog could not be read. Check the database and open the page again.

Discovery.title: Suppliers
Discovery.description: Search by name, product, and category. Filters stay in the page address.
Discovery.scoreNote: Match score: category 35%, geography 25%, price 15%, MOQ 10%, certifications 10%, delivery 5%.
Discovery.emptyText: Change the query or reset the filters.
Discovery.errorText: Suppliers could not be read. Check the database and open the page again.

Profile.title: Supplier profile
Profile.saveFirst: Save this supplier to track contact status and notes.
Profile.errorText: This supplier could not be read. Open the page again.

Compare.title: Comparison
Compare.description: Up to three suppliers side by side. Highlighting marks the stronger value when the figures differ.
Compare.legend: Green marks a lower price, a lower minimum order, more certification records, or delivery terms that are filled in. It is not a company audit.
Compare.emptyText: Add up to three suppliers from the catalog.
Compare.errorText: The selected suppliers could not be read.

Favorites.emptyText: Save a supplier from the catalog to keep notes and a contact status.
Favorites.errorText: The shortlist could not be read.
